title: An Empirical Study on Improving LLM-Based Issue Classification through Domain-Informed Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.13470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Issue reports that describe Intrinsic Bugs, Extrinsic Bugs, and Not a Bug cases often use similar language, but they might point to different causes and require different maintenance actions. This makes three-way issue classification difficult for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly when prompt-based refinements begin to plateau. We study whether domain-informed analysis of LLM outputs can improve classification beyond prompt modification alone. Using 428 manually labeled issue reports, we evaluate six LLMs across 18 prompt configurations and analyze 7,704 model-generated rationales to identify recurring failure patterns in how models justify predictions, use evidence, and handle conflicting information. We translate these findings into a multi-stage pipeline that separates bug validity from bug origin. The pipeline improves macro F1 and Extrinsic Bug recall for five of the six models. translated_title: 基于领域知识分析改进大语言模型问题分类的实证研究
translated_abstract: 描述内在缺陷、外在缺陷和非缺陷案例的问题报告通常使用相似的语言表述，但它们可能指向不同的原因，并需要不同的维护措施。这使得三方问题分类对大型语言模型而言十分困难，尤其是在基于提示词的优化开始趋于停滞时。我们研究了基于提示词修改之外的、对LLM输出进行领域知识分析能否提升分类效果。通过使用428份人工标注的问题报告，我们评估了六个LLM在18种提示词配置下的表现，并分析了7,704条模型生成的推理依据，以识别模型在解释预测、使用证据和处理冲突信息时反复出现的失败模式。我们将这些发现转化为一个将缺陷有效性与缺陷来源相分离的多阶段流水线。该流水线提升了六个模型中五个模型的宏观F1分数和外在缺陷召回率。最强的流水线配置达到了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过对LLM输出推理依据的领域知识分析，构建将缺陷有效性判断与缺陷来源区分相分离的多阶段分类流水线，能够在提示词优化之外显著提升问题的三方分类性能。
en_tdlr: Domain-informed analysis of LLM-generated rationales enables a multi-stage pipeline that separates bug validity from bug origin, improving three-way issue classification beyond prompt engineering alone.
